# spaceman space

Spaces: create, edit, pause, archive, purge and relocate.

Aliases: `spaces`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman space archive`](#spaceman-space-archive) | Archive a space (needs no active runs) |
| [`spaceman space create`](#spaceman-space-create) | Create a space pinned to a node |
| [`spaceman space get`](#spaceman-space-get) | Show a space (ID or slug) |
| [`spaceman space list`](#spaceman-space-list) | List the spaces you can see |
| [`spaceman space pause`](#spaceman-space-pause) | Pause a space |
| [`spaceman space purge`](#spaceman-space-purge) | Permanently delete an archived space's records (never upstream repositories) |
| [`spaceman space relocate`](#spaceman-space-relocate) | Move a space to another node: precheck, start, status, retry, cancel, release |
| [`spaceman space restore`](#spaceman-space-restore) | Restore an archived space |
| [`spaceman space resume`](#spaceman-space-resume) | Resume a paused space |
| [`spaceman space update`](#spaceman-space-update) | Edit a space's profile (only the flags given change) |

## spaceman space archive

Archive a space (needs no active runs).

```sh
spaceman space archive <space> [flags]
```

API: `get-space`, `set-space-state` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |

## spaceman space create

Create a space pinned to a node.

```sh
spaceman space create <slug> [flags]
```

API: `create-space` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman space create payments --name Payments --node build-01
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--description` | string |  | description |
| `--description-file` | string |  | read --description from a file (- reads standard input) |
| `--disconnect-policy` | string |  | interrupt or kill: what happens to runs when the node disconnects |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--goals` | string |  | goals |
| `--goals-file` | string |  | read --goals from a file (- reads standard input) |
| `--idempotency-key` | string |  | Idempotency-Key to send (default: a fresh random key); reuse it to retry this create safely |
| `--name` | string |  | display name |
| `--node` | string |  | node ID or name the space is pinned to (required) |
| `--standing-instructions` | string |  | standing instructions for the space's agents |
| `--standing-instructions-file` | string |  | read --standing-instructions from a file (- reads standard input) |

## spaceman space pause

Pause a space.

```sh

```

API: `get-space`, `set-space-state` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
| `--mode` | string |  | hold (admit no new work, default), interrupt (also stop runs politely) or emergency (kill runs) |

|---|---|
| [`spaceman space relocate cancel`](#spaceman-space-relocate-cancel) | Cancel a relocation before it finalizes (the space stays on its source, paused) |

| [`spaceman space relocate release`](#spaceman-space-relocate-release) | Delete the source folder the latest relocation retained |
| [`spaceman space relocate retry`](#spaceman-space-relocate-retry) | Resume a blocked relocation |
| [`spaceman space relocate start`](#spaceman-space-relocate-start) | Relocate a stopped space to another node |
| [`spaceman space relocate status`](#spaceman-space-relocate-status) | The relocation in progress, or the latest one |


## spaceman space relocate precheck

Inspect the source for a relocation; nothing changes.

```sh

```

API: `start-relocation` ([HTTP API](../api)).

|---|---|---|---|
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--idempotency-key` | string |  | Idempotency-Key to send (default: a fresh random key); reuse it to retry this create safely |
| `--to` | string |  | destination node ID or name (required) |
| `--wait` | bool |  | poll until the relocation finishes, is blocked or fails |
| `--wait-timeout` | duration | `30m0s` | give up waiting after this long |

## spaceman space relocate retry

Resume a blocked relocation.

```sh

```

API: `retry-relocation` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dirty-state` | string |  | change the policy first: export carries the reported state through central |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--wait` | bool |  | poll until the relocation finishes, is blocked or fails |
| `--wait-timeout` | duration | `30m0s` | give up waiting after this long |

## spaceman space relocate start

Relocate a stopped space to another node.

Starts a clean relocation: the source syncs memory and uploads and its repositories are checked; unpushed, changed or untracked work is refused unless --dirty-state export. When the source node is offline, disabled or revoked, --source-unavailable relocates from central's copies only; it needs --acknowledge-loss and --acknowledgement with your own words (recorded in the audit log), and --repo url[@branch][=path] for each repository to clone on the destination.

```sh
spaceman space relocate start <space> [flags]
```

API: `start-relocation` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman space relocate start payments --to build-02 --stop-runs --wait
spaceman space relocate start payments --to build-02 --source-unavailable --acknowledge-loss \
  --acknowledgement "build-01 died; unpushed work there is lost" --repo https://git.example.com/pay.git@main
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--acknowledge-loss` | bool |  | with --source-unavailable: acknowledge that local state on the source may be lost |
| `--acknowledgement` | string |  | with --source-unavailable: your own words, recorded in the audit log |
| `--dirty-state` | string |  | refuse (default: stop at unpushed, changed or untracked state) or export (carry it through central) |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--idempotency-key` | string |  | Idempotency-Key to send (default: a fresh random key); reuse it to retry this create safely |
| `--recovery` | string |  | what happens to the source folder: retain (default) or delete |
| `--repo` | string, repeatable |  | with --source-unavailable: repository to clone, as url[@branch][=path] (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `--retain-days` | integer |  | with retain: days to keep the source folder (0 keeps it until released) |
| `--source-unavailable` | bool |  | relocate from central's copies only, because the source is offline, disabled or revoked |
| `--stop-runs` | bool |  | pause the space (interrupt) and stop its runs first; otherwise it must already be paused with no active runs |
| `--to` | string |  | destination node ID or name (required) |
| `--wait` | bool |  | poll until the relocation finishes, is blocked or fails |
| `--wait-timeout` | duration | `30m0s` | give up waiting after this long |
